prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training day with high-intensity 2-hour run session; need carb-loading for endurance performance

solution_criteria: Meal plan totals 3,500+ calories with carbohydrates comprising 55-65% of total calories
Includes pre-workout meal (1-2 hours before run) with easily digestible carbs and minimal fiber/fat
Includes post-workout meal (within 30-60 minutes after run) with carbs and protein for recovery
All meals are vegetarian and nut-free
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-performance endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring 3,500+ calories with specific carb-loading ratios and timing around training windows
